syllabus_topic: Ancient India (IVC, Vedic, Mauryan, Gupta, kingdoms)
Medieval India (Delhi Sultanate, Mughals, Bhakti-Sufi, regional)
Art & Culture (architecture, painting, dance, music, literature)
World History (revolutions, world wars, decolonisation) — Mains only, light in Prelims
Union executive (President, PM, Council of Ministers)
Judiciary — SC, HC, judicial review, PIL
Constitutional & statutory bodies (EC, CAG, UPSC, NHRC, FC, etc.)
Agriculture economics — MSP, subsidies, food security
External sector — BoP, trade, forex, FDI
Economic reforms / LPG / planning / NITI Aayog
Ecology basics — ecosystems, food chains, biogeochemical cycles
Protected areas — NP, WLS, biosphere reserves, Ramsar
Climate change — UNFCCC, IPCC, COP, carbon markets
Pollution — air, water, soil, e-waste, plastic
Environmental laws & institutions (EPA, NGT, CPCB, MoEFCC)
Biology — human body, genetics, health & disease
Current events of national & international importance
